title: Degradation-Aware Multi-Sensor Fusion with Lightweight Confidence Estimation: code for the PCDS 2026 paper
description: Code for the paper "Degradation-Aware Multi-Sensor Fusion with Lightweight Confidence Estimation for Resource-Constrained Mobile Robots" (PCDS 2026). Calibrated per-measurement confidence estimators adapt the EKF measurement covariance under camera, LiDAR, IMU and wheel-odometry degradation. Includes the simulator, degradation generators, front-ends, quality features, estimators, confidence-aware EKF and baselines, evaluation and statistics scripts, configurations with all random seeds, and the tables and figures of the reported run. Simulation-only study.
